The Concord

Human · homeworld Earth

Humans: adaptable and restless. Three centuries in the corridors have scattered them across dozens of colonies and competing governments.

Trait
Restless energy. Colony and outpost ships cost 25% less, and new colonies start with 2 population.
Leader
First Speaker Amara Voss, idealists: They prize treaties and keep their word; they don't forgive a broken one.
Ships
Angular, modular hulls: Earth's yards build what works, and bolt on more. Wayfarer scout · Lancer frigate · Aegis cruiser · Sovereign dreadnought · Mayflower colony ship · Homestead outpost ship · Marathon troop transport · Wellspring fuel tanker

The Tessan Dynasties

Tessan · homeworld Tessa Prime

Large, scaled and exceptionally long-lived, with heavy jaws and hooded eyes. Their dynasties hold debts older than human history.

Trait
Old money. +25% credits from every world, and trade treaties pay double.
Leader
Dynast Oruvel Tess, merchant princes: Everything has a price with them, and they remember every debt, both ways.
Ships
Sweeping curves and crescent wings: old money builds to be admired. Envoy scout · Courtier frigate · Magistrate cruiser · Dynast dreadnought · Dowry colony ship · Tollhouse outpost ship · Retinue troop transport · Cistern fuel tanker

The Kel Hives

Kel · homeworld Kel'vaar

Chitin-plated hive beings with compound eyes and mandibles. They think as one, and isolation distresses them.

Trait
Hive-cities. Worlds hold 2 more population, and population grows faster.
Leader
The Speaker-Mind of Kel'vaar, the patient hive: Slow to anger and slower to forget. They hate anyone who settles near the hives.
Ships
Segmented hulls grown in the hive-yards, bristling with mandibles. Drone scout · Stinger frigate · Mandible cruiser · Hivemother dreadnought · Swarmseed colony ship · Burrow outpost ship · Broodcarrier troop transport · Nectar fuel tanker

The Hegemony Remnant

Ozhvek and Dresh · homeworld Ozhvar

The Ozhvek: massive, radially symmetrical, six-limbed, with mineralized plates and sensory clusters all around. With them stand the Dresh, the four-armed, heavily armored soldiers of a high-gravity world.

Trait
Imperial legions. Warships hit on +1, and troop transports land twice the force.
Leader
Warlord Ozhan Dresh, proud legions: They respect strength and despise weakness. Refuse them and be ready to back it up.
Ships
Heavy armoured prows and spiked fins: the legions' ships are built to frighten. Outrider scout · Gladius frigate · Praetor cruiser · Imperator dreadnought · Colonia colony ship · Castellum outpost ship · Cohort troop transport · Aqueduct fuel tanker

The Vael Living Fleets

Vael · homeworld The Long Flotilla

Long-bodied, lightly built, four-limbed, from a low-gravity world. They live aboard ships that are alive.

Trait
Living hulls. Ships move 1 hex farther and repair a point of hull every turn, anywhere.
Leader
Shipmother Ilae, the wanderers: Curious and proud of their freedom; they hate being fenced in, and love a fellow traveller.
Ships
Living ships: rays and fish the size of towers, with fins and trailing tails. Mote scout · Darter frigate · Manta cruiser · Abyssal dreadnought · Spore colony ship · Coral outpost ship · Shoal troop transport · Wellfin fuel tanker

The Mirrun Commonwealth

Mirrun · homeworld Oluun

Smooth-skinned amphibians from a deep-ocean world, with large eyes and pressure-sensitive skin. Agile swimmers, and famous for their humor.

Trait
Pelagic scholars. +20% science on every world, and Ocean worlds hold 3 more population.
Leader
Tidecaller Veshu, the deliberators: Witty, patient and hard to rush; they defend ocean worlds fiercely and despise strip-miners.
Ships
Smooth teardrop hulls with fins and gill-vents: built to slip through pressure, in water or in the fold. Ripple scout · Barracuda frigate · Leviathan cruiser · Trench dreadnought · Tidepool colony ship · Buoy outpost ship · Current troop transport · Reservoir fuel tanker

The Ylith Aeries

Ylith · homeworld Skyrrin

Hollow-boned, feathered gliders with broad wing-membranes and extraordinary eyes. Confined spaces are profoundly uncomfortable for them.

Trait
Far sight. Ships and worlds see 2 hexes farther, and scouts and colony ships move 1 faster.
Leader
Windmarshal Kirrae, the high watchers: Proud, far-seeing and restless; they love open space and hate being boxed in.
Ships
Swept wings and feathered vanes: the Ylith build ships that look ready to glide. Kestrel scout · Harrier frigate · Condor cruiser · Skylord dreadnought · Nestling colony ship · Eyrie outpost ship · Flock troop transport · Updraft fuel tanker

The Zhaq Free Republics

Zhaq · homeworld Zhaqar

Flexible, tripedal beings with segmented limbs and three independently focusing eyes, able to sleep through hard times for years.

Trait
Never again. Their worlds' garrisons are half again as strong and never weaken under siege, and a besieged world starves half as fast.
Leader
First Citizen Thrix-Ammol, the defiant: Free, stubborn and suspicious of empires; they never forgive anyone who tries to rule them.
Ships
Three-pronged, segmented hulls: Zhaq ships stand on three struts, like their builders on three legs. Watcher scout · Sentinel frigate · Bastion cruiser · Republic dreadnought · Seedvault colony ship · Tripod outpost ship · Cohort troop transport · Cache fuel tanker

Fracture Lines: Dominion, a strategy game in the Fracture Lines setting of the Legend Dynamics RPG. The peoples are described in the setting's guide.
